Prevent snapshots from reporting inflated loaded coin counts or delaying node shutdown during import
agreement: Strong support with multiple tested approvals and no open objections
Verified duplicate records and empty groups are rejected on regtest and in fuzz targets (cyb3ralbert)
Verified duplicate records fail on head but pass on base in functional tests (fametrano)
Light approval without deep domain review (danielabrozzoni)
